column8: Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.State → ℕ → Option ℕ → Prop := fun state object epoch => state.object = object ∧ state.mode = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Mode.active ∧ epoch = Option.some state.epoch

∀ (s : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.State) (id : ℕ), s.mode = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Mode.active → id ≠ s.transition → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Step s { object := s.object, epoch := s.epoch, parent := s.transition, transition := id, audience := s.audience, devices := s.devices, history := s.history, manifest := s.manifest, mode := Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Mode.frozen, authoritySnapshot := s.authoritySnapshot, deviceSnapshot := s.deviceSnapshot }

∀ (s : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.State) (audience devices history manifest authoritySnapshot deviceSnapshot : ℕ), s.mode = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Mode.frozen → manifest ≠ 0 → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Step s { object := s.object, epoch := s.epoch + 1, parent := s.parent, transition := s.transition, audience := audience, devices := devices, history := history, manifest := manifest, mode := Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Mode.active, authoritySnapshot := authoritySnapshot, deviceSnapshot := deviceSnapshot }
∀ (s : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.State), s.mode = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Mode.frozen → ∀ (object : ℕ) (epoch : Option ℕ), ¬Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Fresh s object epoch

∀ (s : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.State) (a d h m object : ℕ), ¬Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Fresh { object := s.object, epoch := s.epoch + 1, parent := s.parent, transition := s.transition, audience := a, devices := d, history := h, manifest := m, mode := Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Mode.active, authoritySnapshot := s.authoritySnapshot, deviceSnapshot := s.deviceSnapshot } object (Option.some s.epoch)
∀ (s : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.State) (object epoch : ℕ), epoch ≠ s.epoch → ¬Minidregg.Theory.ObjectAudience.Fresh s object (Option.some epoch)
